purpose: Synthetic, anonymised readiness scenarios for regression and future human calibration.

scenarios.name: conventional_thesis_with_core_evidence
documents: Research Question: How can rural health services address a significant policy gap in mental health access? This study contributes original knowledge by introducing a regional governance framework.
The conceptual framework integrates the literature review and guides the research objectives.
The methodology was selected because it was appropriate for the research question. Participants were recruited using a documented procedure, with triangulation supporting validity.
The findings address the research objectives and are presented in Table 4. Unexpected findings are explained by sampling limitations.
These findings extend previous research. Future research should investigate transferability to remote communities.

scenarios.name: publication_based_thesis_with_minimum_treatment
documents: This thesis by publication includes published work. The introduction contains an independent and original review of the relevant literature.
The framing chapter frames the publications within the wider discipline.
Bridging statements link chapters into a cohesive narrative.
The independent general discussion integrates the findings and future research needs.

scenarios.name: practice_based_thesis_with_integration_and_ai_disclosure
documents: This practice-based thesis includes an exegesis and a creative work. The exegesis and creative work are examined as an integrated whole.
ChatGPT was used to assist with language editing. Its use was limited to Chapter 2, and the prompt log is included in Appendix A.
